text_block_list.text:
After school, while having tea and discussing things
with Agnes Digital—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeeh?! K-K-K-Karaoke?
W-With someone like me... and everyone else?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I got free tickets, so let's all party down☆ sorta thing!
Windy and Doto are coming too, so let's have a Halloween party~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to come along too, Trainer-san?
It's for up to 6 people, so we were saying it'd be a waste to leave one spot empty!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeeeh, it's finally here...!
Degitan is humbled beyond belief...!
choice_data_list: (She says that, but she looks so happy...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayyy!
First up! Me!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *dash-dash*! Here's your microphone...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ghehe~! I'm gonna make a total ruckus~!
Hey! Hey! Look at me~!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It's so lively and nice!
I-I should join in too...! Yeaaah?
Um, how do I cheer properly...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I brought cheer gear too!
Please wave this around~~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! Doto-san's drink is
right on the very edge of the table!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This is dangerous... *scurries further inside*...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu, thanks Digital.
Wait, aren't you watching me way too closely?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Um, well, I guess you could say
I was just kinda curious~...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get it.
I'm the type to worry about that stuff too.
Helios spills things all the time, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"You know, maybe we're more alike than we thought?
Like how we can't help keeping an eye on everyone."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyoe! S-S-Similar, you say...!
B-But I understand what you're trying to say~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, seeing everyone having fun
just brings me so much happiness...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa?!
Digi-tan, aren't you singing? Are you having fun?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right...!
I'm so sorry I didn't notice!
What should we sing...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Muoooh...?! No, no...!
You really don't need to worry about someone like me...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Holding back is so annoying, nanoda!
Just let me hear your song already, nanodaaa!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ababababa... It's not that I'm being modest...!
If it's anison, I've got a whole mountain of songs I could sing, but...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I want everyone to have fun...!
So singing a song that only I enjoy would be, well...!"
choice_data_list: Don't you think everyone wants to get to know you?
Don't you think everyone wants to get to know you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I want everyone to have fun...!
So singing a song that only I enjoy would be, well...!"
choice_data_list: Don't you think everyone wants to get to know you?
Don't you think everyone wants to get to know you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...! Does 'everyone' include me too...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! If you're not having fun too,
Digitan, I'm gonna feel a little lonely~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ununununu...!
If you say something like that to me...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...T-Then, can I really just
do whatever I find 'fun'
without holding back...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In that case...! To be honest, what brings me
the absolute most joy is seeing the Umamusume
having a blast...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In other words! Singing songs where everyone can see that!
That is what it truly means for "me to be enjoying myself"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, Digi-tan is gonna sing!
That timeless, all-time fan favorite track!
Hit the musiiiiiic!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oooo, umadacchi!
Ooo, umapyoi! Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooo, sukidacchi!
Ooo, umapoi!
Uma-uma-umya-unya, 3, 2, 1, fight!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhhhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, alright! There's no Umamusume who
wouldn't get hyped by this~♪
Haaah~~ Everyone's so cute~~! Such a feast for the eyes~!!)

It seemed everyone—Agnes Digital included—
had a wonderful time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What... did you say...!?
You want to... get to know me...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I see... They might be my "faves,"
but to them, we're all "friends" attending
the same academy...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*Deep breath*...
Unworthy Digi-tan here has made up her mind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Geeking out to someone who isn't interested is strictly forbidden.
However! If everyone wishes to know!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've heard this song before~.
If I recall, it was popular decades ago...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan wasn't even born yet! For that matter, Digital wasn't born yet either!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Right! Allow me to explain during the interlude!
This is a historic masterpiece, you see! It has become a revival hit time and again with different lyrics!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It was originally a cheer song for a certain Umamusume, but the band members were always late, so it turned into a comical song with lyrics teasing him to "run"—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Puhahaha! That fast-talking is crazy~~!
I kinda love this song! It cracks me up!
Run~♪ Run~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I love this one too. I'm pretty sure my grandmother had the original vinyl record~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa!!? That's so rare!
As expected of the Mejiro Grandmotherrr~~!!

The conversation branched out even further after that,
and everyone got super excited!
